candidate.destination: Tab5 J9 pin 2 SYS_VIN / pin 1 GND

requirements.text: Tab5 input must stay within 6–24 V during enabled operation; establish transient limits from internal part ratings separately.
Perform shutdown before planned power removal. After direct disconnection wait at least 5 s before powering on again.
Keep Tab5 branch off during pack predischarge. Enable only after the main protected supply is established.
Use a dedicated protected, default-off Tab5 branch. Do not feed it through the servo 5 V output or the small STOP auxiliary supply.
Treat brownout or unknown power history as requiring a fresh off interval; 5 s of a disabled command alone does not prove removal of actual power.
Loss of control validity inhibits servo drive; Tab5 restart alone must not rearm it. Require verified readiness and a fresh explicit arm request.

modes.action: inhibit servo drive, request Tab5 shutdown, confirm shutdown before disconnect
modes.timeout_policy: not selected; do not infer shutdown from elapsed time

modes.action: protective cutoff takes precedence over orderly shutdown
modes.restart: latched off; fresh power-off interval at least 5 s, power validity and readiness required

modes.action: disconnect robot pack and prevent servo energization before USB attachment
modes.qualification: communication-line backfeed and physical interlock remain unverified

modes.action: remove battery from robot and use compatible external balance charger
modes.qualification: charger and disconnect hardware remain subject to final BOM review

not_inferred: 6 h typical runtime is not a peak-current rating
5 s is not proof of internal rail discharge or a guaranteed boot time
nominal 3S compatibility is not transient or protection qualification
no USB/NP-F550 in candidate is not a user prohibition
open_design_items: branch IC and connector current ratings, current limit and startup capacitance
off-state leakage, reverse paths and physical power-off observation
timer retained or safe restart behavior when its own power is lost
whole-system power budget including Tab5 peaks
readiness, rearm interface and fault response deadlines
